$comment: AUTHORITATIVE CONTRACT SOURCE OF TRUTH. Hand-edited. Everything under packages/contracts/generated/ is derived from this file by tools/generate.py. See ADR-009.

identifiers.name: UserId
identifiers.description: A principal. Not a tenant. See ADR-005.

identifiers.name: WorkspaceId
identifiers.description: The tenant boundary. Required on every tenant-scoped contract.

identifiers.name: ResearchProjectId
identifiers.description: Persistent workspace-scoped research objective. Ontology V2 §11.2.

identifiers.name: ResearchSessionId
identifiers.description: The only persisted execution entity. Ontology V2 §11.4. Replaces the retired 'run_id'.

identifiers.name: OpportunityId
identifiers.description: A domain hypothesis. Not owned by the session that found it. Ontology V2 §12.

identifiers.name: EvidenceId
identifiers.description: An evidence record with mandatory provenance.

identifiers.name: SourceId
identifiers.description: A registered external source. Global, not tenant-scoped. Registry contents are D-07, still open.

closed_enums.name: ClaimType
closed_enums.description: How an analytical statement is supported. Never conflated in any output.

values.description: Derived analytically from one or more observations
A model-generated estimate about an unknown or future outcome
A proposed action or decision generated by the system
A plausible proposition that currently lacks sufficient evidence

closed_enums.name: MarketScopeType
closed_enums.description: Geographic scope discriminator. Geographic axis only; segment scoping is A-12 and is NOT modelled.

values.description: One or more region registry identifiers
Aggregate across two or more named markets

closed_enums.name: ResearchSessionStatus
closed_enums.description: Session lifecycle. Budget exhaustion is COMPLETED with reduced Research Completeness, never a status. A session that finds nothing is COMPLETED, not FAILED.

values.description: Building the research plan and budget
Finished, whether coverage was complete or partial
Could not produce a usable result

closed_enums.name: DemandSignalFamily
closed_enums.description: Closed. Signal TYPES within a family are a registry, not an enum.

values.description: Launches, funding, search growth, platform change

closed_enums.name: ScoreFamily
closed_enums.description: The five families. Never collapsed into a single number, not in an API, a sort key or a badge.

values.description: How attractive, given the research context
How strong and diverse the supporting evidence is
How feasible under the requested constraints
How much of the relevant space was examined
How confident the model is in its interpretation. A SCORE on 0-100, not a confidence field.

closed_enums.name: LlmTier
closed_enums.description: Logical tier. Business services request a tier, never a provider or model name.

closed_enums.name: RegistryStatus
closed_enums.description: Deprecation, never deletion. A deprecated entry stops being offered for new classification but keeps resolving for historical records.

numeric_types.name: Confidence
numeric_types.description: How much the system trusts a value or interpretation. Presented as a percentage.

numeric_types.name: Probability
numeric_types.description: Likelihood of an event or outcome.

numeric_types.name: Independence
numeric_types.description: Estimated independence from other evidence. The threshold gating evidence level 3 is A-04 and remains UNDEFINED.

numeric_types.name: Score
numeric_types.description: An assessed magnitude. NOT interchangeable with Confidence.

numeric_types.name: EvidenceLevel
numeric_types.description: 0 Hypothesis, 1 Weak, 2 Repeated, 3 Multi-source, 4 Market evidence, 5 Direct validation. Never rescaled, never averaged into a score.

market_scope.canonicalization: Country codes uppercased, deduplicated, sorted. Region ids lowercased, deduplicated, sorted. One scope therefore has exactly one representation, which is what makes it safe as a cache key, a dedup key and an equality test.

research_context.note: Not an entity. No identity, no lifecycle. Serialized as an immutable snapshot on a ResearchSession.

blocked.what: Evidence aggregation formula, recency decay parameters, independence thresholds, contradiction penalties
blocked.consequence: No aggregation field may be declared in contracts or schema. services/scoring cannot be implemented.

blocked.what: Source registry contents and per-source legal review records
blocked.consequence: SourceId exists as an identifier; no source table contents, no retention_override logic.
MarketScope stays geographic only. No SEGMENT variant.
